description: This file defines a Python module that implements a transformation handler for skills API requests to interact with the LiteLLM database. It includes classes and methods for creating, listing, retrieving, and deleting skills, both synchronously and asynchronously. The code integrates with external modules, specifically within the 'litellm' package, and provides conversion and handling logic for skill data within the LiteLLM framework.
